5 Nov-Release of Vande Mataram in Braille Language
On 5th November, Magazine on Vande Mataram in Braille language was released by the hands of Governor of Maharashtra for Blind Welfare Organisation at Raj Bhavan.
The function was attended by IPP Rtn Noopur Desai and Rtn Suhit Jhaveri
Project cost Rs 25,000/- @ Rs 8,500 per set
